subject: Request: one-off pilot (no-PO) — MicroMart Analytics
messages:
From: Jules Martin <jules@micromart.io>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Ops <procure@micromart.io>
Date: Sun, 13 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot engagement — request for one-off no-PO path

Hi Hannah,

Thanks for taking a look. We’re kicking off a short 6-week pilot with MicroMart that’s focused on our data ingestion pipeline — estimated spend is $4,800 for the period. Our procurement team prefers a PO, but given the timeline and internal billing cycles we’d like to request a one-off invoice route (no PO) for the pilot and then convert to standard PO for any subsequent commitments.

I’ve attached a short SOW and a brief vendor profile (micromart_pilot_sow.pdf). Can you confirm what evidence is required to qualify for a temporary no-PO allowance and whether Redwood can issue a single invoice? Also looping in our CFO (cfo@micromart.io) for visibility.

Next steps we propose:
- Redwood confirms evidence checklist + approval lane
- MicroMart returns completed vendor form + W9 (if needed)
- Redwood issues invoice at pilot completion or net-30, whichever works

Appreciate any fast-track guidance — pilot starts next Monday.

Best,
Jules Martin
Head of Data Partnerships
MicroMart Analytics

Attachments: micromart_pilot_sow.pdf (application/pdf)

Subject: Fwd: Pilot engagement — request for one-off no-PO path

Marissa / Priyom — forwarding Jules’ request from MicroMart. Pilot $4.8k, starts next Monday. External asks for a single-invoice (no PO) for the pilot window and will move to standard PO later if we proceed.

Quick context: MicroMart is a small analytics shop (existing contact through solutions demos). Risk looks low but we need procurement sign-off + evidence. Can we run this through the temporary invoice-only lane? If yes, what do you need from MicroMart (W9, indemnities, SSO, data handling attestation)?

I think this is a good candidate for temporary allowance given dollar amount and strategic fit — but want ops/procurement checklist completed before I confirm.

Thanks — Hannah

Hannah, Marissa — quick checklist from procurement to evaluate temporary invoice path: 

Required evidence (for a 30-day temporary allowance):
1) Completed vendor intake form (signed) — includes legal name, tax id, payment remit details
2) W9 or equivalent tax document (for US vendors)
3) Short SOW (scope, dates, fixed cost) — we have this (thanks)
4) Primary contact and escalation contact (phone + email)
5) Data handling attestation if the engagement touches PII or customer data (MicroMart confirms NO PII in pilot)
6) Minimum insurance: general liability (or confirmation of being a small supplier with internal approval) — waiver possible for <$5k pilot but note on file
7) Approval from finance ops (we need Laura)

I’ve attached a one-page evidence checklist you can send to MicroMart (micro-vendor-evidence.zip contains the form and W9 template). If they return everything within 48 hours we can approve an invoice-only route with the following conditions:
- Single invoice covering the full pilot amount
- Invoice payable net-30 to Redwood (we’ll bill MicroMart)
- Redwood retains right to pause services until vendor routing is converted to PO for future work

Marissa / Laura — can you confirm finance ops sign-off if MicroMart returns the items above?

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Procurement Lead
Redwood Inference

Attachments: micro-vendor-evidence.zip (contains: vendor_intake_form.pdf, w9-template.pdf)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Sep 2026 10:52:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Pilot engagement — request for one-off no-PO path

All — I reviewed the SOW and the vendor history. MicroMart has done small pilots with two other startups; financial exposure is low. Laura — if procurement receives the intake form + W9 and MicroMart confirms no PII and agrees to our pause-rights for non-payment, finance is okay to approve a temporary invoice-only route. Please add an accounting note referencing DL-4721 and route the invoice to the billing alias.

Hannah — you can confirm to Jules that we’ll allow the single-invoice approach provided the checklist is complete and we get the W9. Also confirm payment terms (net-30) and that future work will require a PO.

Marissa Cole
Head of Growth Ops (acting)
Redwood Inference
